bear_case: Counter-argument: weekend crypto moves of -0.5% are within normal low-volume chop range and should not be read as confirmation of a regime change. The absence of further panic over the weekend — no DXY ripping higher, no gold catching a fear bid, no follow-through equity selling overnight — is consistent with Friday being a localized flush rather than the start of a multi-week drawdown. Historically, meaningful market lows tend to form on Fridays when fear peaks; Monday's gap-down could mark exactly that low. Sizing of any short positions should reflect the limited new data since Friday's close.
